body.name: prescribed-complement reachable-fixing transition
body.construction:
For the least one-district task selected by the compiler, let \(D\) be the district required by the recursive case and let \(D'\) be its computed proper ambient district. Write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\zeta'\) only for the next vertex \(W_j\) in the compiler's lexicographically least valid fixing sequence of the prescribed complement \(D'\setminus D\). Thus no vertex of \(D\) and no arbitrary vertex of \(Y_\tau\) is eligible. At prefix \(j\), eligibility requires
\[
 \operatorname{dis}_{G_j}(W_j)\cap\operatorname{de}_{G_j}(W_j)=\{W_j\}.
\]
Write the current kernel over a common already registered positive denominator as \(K_j=N_j/D_j\), compute
\[
 m_j=\sum_{x_{W_j}}K_j=\frac{\sum_{x_{W_j}}N_j}{D_j},
 \qquad K_{j+1}=\frac{K_j}{m_j},
\]
and register the reduced factors of \(m_j\). The numerator certificate is constructed by the displayed finite summation from the previously reachable positive kernel cells, and the denominator certificate is constructed by concatenating the earlier ledger factors in \(D_j\). Move \(W_j\) from the task's random mask to its fixed mask, check \(m_jK_{j+1}=K_j\) after cross-multiplication modulo \(\mathcal J\), and regenerate only the suffix of this same prescribed complement sequence.
